items.t: In Fleetwood Tynehead, houses sold at a median of $1,367,500 across 118 sales, and the middle half closed between $1,177,500 and $1,646,250. The median house sat 36 days and sold for 95.5% of list.
Fleetwood Tynehead: 158 townhomes sold at a median of $800,000, with the middle half between $726,625 and $844,500. The median townhome took 24 days to sell and closed at 97.6% of list.

41 condos sold in Fleetwood Tynehead at a median of $510,000 (middle half $439,900 to $590,000). A typical condo in Fleetwood Tynehead spent 32 days on the market and closed at 97.8% of the asking price.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Fleetwood Tynehead compares with the rest of Surrey

items.t: Houses in Fleetwood Tynehead have the 4th highest median of 7 Surrey sub-areas, $1,367,500. Queen Mary Park Surrey is lowest at $1,178,500 and Sullivan Station highest at $1,397,200. Bear Creek Green Timbers ($1,272,000) sits just below and Panorama Ridge ($1,380,000) sits just above.

Of 7 Surrey sub-areas with 5 or more townhome sales, Fleetwood Tynehead ranks second highest at $800,000; the range is $616,750 (East Newton) to $800,000 (Panorama Ridge). Sullivan Station ($785,000) sits just below and Panorama Ridge ($800,000) sits just above.

Condos in Fleetwood Tynehead have the third highest median of 6 Surrey sub-areas, $510,000. Queen Mary Park Surrey is lowest at $436,500 and Sullivan Station highest at $574,000. West Newton ($475,000) sits just below and Bear Creek Green Timbers ($521,500) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, condos are the newest homes selling in Fleetwood Tynehead (median 2022) and houses the oldest (median 1991), a gap of 31 years.
